> The trailer was broken in early AM Sep 1st (I was not there) No damage was
> done to it.  Two TV's, two VCR's, two guns, 3 coin banks and some ammo was
> taken, LOT'S was overlooked.  All they had to do was snap the bolt on that
> back door with a screwdriver, hardly a mark left.  My reliance on Paul and
> Agnes (who are in sight of the door) was misguided; they go to sleep
before
> dark.  Your keys will not fit the new deadbolt replacing the passage lock,
> that was in place within two hours of my return.  Trying to think of
things
> to secure before travel season (October) gets here.... On a more serious
> note, Luke Villar was shot and killed before 6am Saturday cleaning up
> entrance to Delaunes Gro where he worked.  He is a grandson of Joe
Duplussis
> (son of Charmaine) only 17 years old.  He was buried today, you may want
to
> contact Joe or Charmaine.  Two guys were arrested yesterday, they
confessed
> to the deed while being questioned for a theft case.  One lives only 1/2
> mile from the trailer.  What with the new war, this stuff, and trying to
> repair Norman's equipment it's getting a little much...now if only
> Christine's would be a false pregnancy, would help....rrrrrrr
